page0.text:
It's 7 PM.
Tohsaka came right on time.

page1.text:
"Sorry to keep you waiting. It took a while since I was getting the necessary things.
How's your preparation?"
...
I hand her the practice sword bag.
There's a bokutou, a wooden sword, inside.
This is all the preparation I can do.

page2.text: "...Well, I guess that makes sense. Anyway, we have Saber for hand-to-hand combat. You might just end up watching."

page3.text:
"That's true. As long as Saber is here, all I have to do is back her up."
...Well, I find it hard to think of a situation where I actually need to watch her back.

page4.text:
"Rin. Why is Archer not here?"
Then...
With a sharp look, Saber asks a question.

page5.text:
"Huh...? Tohsaka, you didn't bring Archer?"
"...Yes, I left him home. We're doing a surprise attack tonight, so we don't need him if we have Saber, right? To be honest, I don't want him anywhere near Caster."

page6.text:
Tohsaka starts walking.
...I don't know what she's thinking, but that means that we won't have the help of Archer this time.

page7.text:
...Time passes.
We have to cross this intersection to get to Ryudou Temple from school.

page8.text:
It's already taken an hour to set up our territory.
The simple Bounded Field set up by Tohsaka...
"We're screwed if we're seen, but the soundproofing is perfect.
Nobody would even notice if a missile exploded here."
According to Tohsaka.

page9.text:
The surrounding area is too quiet.
It might also be because Tohsaka's field is working, but everything feels too lifeless.
It's already been seven days since the Holy Grail War started.
It seems like the town's spirit is being slowly stripped away without anyone noticing.

page10.text:
"...He's here. Hide, Emiya."
"Hnn..."
I move to the wall.
...I can't even hear the footsteps.
There's a figure beneath the streetlight.

page11.text:
A tall and lean physique...
That familiar figure is definitely Souichirou Kuzuki.
Mr. Kuzuki passes by in front of us with his usual orderly footsteps.

page12.text:
...
He's too defenseless.
I'm assaulted with the feeling that Mr. Kuzuki might be innocent.

page13.text:
"...Hey, Tohsaka. Don't you think Mr. Kuzuki might be innocent after all?"
"...Well, we'll find out soon."
Tohsaka seems to be half in doubt as well.
It seems like she's still carrying on with her plan, as she points her index finger towards Mr. Kuzuki.

page14.text:
Gandr.
It is a curse that lowers the target's physical ability, considered to be a simple magecraft.
Tohsaka's is more like a gunshot instead of a Gandr, but I'm sure she'll lower the intensity this time.

page16.text:
...
There's still time.
The possibility that Souichirou Kuzuki is innocent.
Isn't there another way other than Gandr to check if he's a Master or not...?
